result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with a high-visibility continental crosswalk and a traffic signal. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the wide roadway and lack of a pedestrian refuge or visible pedestrian signals increase exposure risk.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to traffic without a refuge island.

hazards.name: Lack of visible pedestrian signal
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal is visible to indicate when it is safe to cross.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear information on remaining crossing time.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a median refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked zebra crosswalks, sidewalks, and curb ramps within a residential row-house context. However, the lack of visible dedicated pedestrian signals and the wide, unmarked roadway increase exposure and potential for higher vehicle speeds.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible, requiring pedestrians to interpret vehicle signals which may not provide adequate clearance time.
hazards.location_in_image: At the signalized corners of the intersection

hazards.name: Wide Unmarked Roadway
hazards.description: The lack of lane markings on a wide street can encourage higher vehicle speeds and unpredictable positioning, increasing risk during crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Main roadway in the foreground and center

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear right-of-way and crossing time information.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance, improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians, and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing and Markings
interventions.description: Add center lines and edge lines to organize traffic and visually narrow the roadway to encourage lower speeds.

result.summary: The intersection features a high-visibility continental crosswalk and sidewalks on both sides, supported by overhead traffic signals. However, the wide roadway creates a significant crossing distance for pedestrians without the protection of a refuge island or curb extensions.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for an extended period without a mid-crossing refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground

hazards.name: Sight line obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the corner may block the view between drivers and pedestrians entering the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image, near the intersection

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve sight lines.

result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and a marked crosswalk, though the markings are heavily faded. While traffic lights are present, there is a lack of visible pedestrian-specific signals and significant sightline obstructions from parked vehicles near the crossing.

hazards.name: Faded crosswalk markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Parked vehicle sightline obstruction
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection corners may block the view between pedestrians waiting to cross and oncoming drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbs on both sides of the street beyond the intersection

interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve sightlines for all road users.
